mkdir -p drafts && cat > drafts/riverside-committee-summary.md <<'EOF'
Subject: Finance committee summary - Thursday 5 Nov [DATE UNVERIFIED]

Hello all,

Thanks for making time Thursday evening. I know this is unpaid time on top of a full week. Here is where we landed.

What we decided

1. The reserve transfer is not ours to decide. Tom suggested moving 5,000 [UNVERIFIED] from the operating reserve to cover program supplies. That goes to the full board on 19 Nov.
2. The packet goes to the board on Thu 12 Nov, one week before the meeting.

Who does what by when

1. Ellis: send corrected Q1 actuals (July to September) by Tue 10 Nov. Two September lines were coded to the wrong account.
2. Ellis: confirm whether the program supplies overage is a timing issue or a real overspend. Alicia, Tom, and I need this before the packet goes out.
3. Ellis: ask the auditor whether fieldwork can happen in February instead of January.
4. Morgan: send the cover memo draft to Ellis by Wed 11 Nov.

What is still open

1. Program supplies are over plan by about 6,500 [UNVERIFIED]. Camp supplies for next summer may have been bought in September, which would make this timing and not overspend. Ellis is checking.
2. Audit fieldwork timing. The auditor wants January. Nothing is decided until Ellis hears back on February.
3. One-page explanation of the reserve transfer for the board. Alicia asked for it ahead of the 19 Nov meeting. Who writes it is not settled.

Revenue for Q1 was roughly on plan.

Next committee meeting is Thu 3 Dec.

Thanks,
Morgan
EOF
grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' drafts/riverside-committee-summary.md | head
